title: Enni Kastalaina – Ebenezer Paul Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: ఎన్ని కష్టాలైనా ఎన్ని నష్టాలైనా నీతోనే నా జీవితం
వ్యాధి బాధలైనా శోక సంద్రమైన నీతోనే నా జీవితం
నీ ప్రేమను చూపించి నీ కౌగిటిలో చేర్చి
నీతోనే నడచి నీలోనే జీవించి నీతోనే సాగెదను
నీతోనే నడచి నీలోనే జీవించి నీతోనే సాగెదను
english: Enni kastaalaina enni nashtaalaina neethone naa jeevitham
Vyaadhi baadhalaina shoka sandhramaina neethone naa jeevitham
Nee premanu choopinchi nee kowgitilo cherchi
Neethone nadachi neelone jeevinchi neethone saagedhanu
Neethone nadachi neelone jeevinchi neethone saagedhanu
translation: O God, this life is dedicated to You.
No matter how many troubles or losses come, my life is with You.
Whether sickness or sorrow like a deep ocean,
Still, my life remains with You.
You showed me Your love and drew me into Your embrace.
You revealed Your path to me.
Walking with You and living in You,
I will continue my journey with You.
You are the light to my path and a lamp to my feet.
Your Word is what guides me.
Walking with You and living in You,
I will continue my journey with You.
intro: Enni Kastalaina is the latest Telugu Christian song written, tuned and music composed by Pastor Ebenezer Paul. This song was released on February 27, 2026, through Pastor Ebenezer paul – My Father’s Home Ministries YouTube Channel.
